question: **Direction: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.**

options.text: ​Its sanctions are based on compairisons between the two companies.
She is going to divorce him on the grounds of adultary.
I was a bit depressed by our apparant lack of progress.
Urban dwellers often accept noise as part of city life.

solution:
The correct answer is** ****"Urban dwellers often accept noise as part of city life."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 
In the given sentence, **"Urban dwellers often accept noise as part of city life,"** all the words are correctly spelled. Here's a brief breakdown:

 
 
• 
 
**"Urban"**: Correctly spelled, referring to things related to cities. (शहरी)

 
 
• 
 
**"Dwellers"**: Correctly spelled, referring to people who live in a particular place. (रहने वाले लोगों)

 
 
• 
 
**"Often"**: Correctly spelled, indicating frequency. (अक्सर)

 
 
• 
 
**"Accept"**: Correctly spelled, meaning to tolerate or acknowledge. (स्वीकार)

 
 
• 
 
**"Noise"**: Correctly spelled, denoting unwanted or disruptive sounds. (शोर)

 
 
• 
 
**"As"**: Correctly spelled, used to compare or describe the role of noise. (जैसा)

 
 
• 
 
**"Part"**: Correctly spelled, indicating a component or element. (भाग)

 
 
• 
 
**"Of"**: Correctly spelled, a preposition indicating a relationship between "noise" and "city life."

 
 
• 
 
**"City"**: Correctly spelled, referring to a large human settlement. (शहर)

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The correct answer is option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Option 1: "compairisons"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"comparisons."**
 
• **Option 2: "adultary"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"adultery."**
 
• **Option 3: "apparant"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"apparent."**
